The following events took place in '''3701 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The scoutship [[Hope (scoutship)|''Hope'']] is disabled and crash-lands on the remote planet of [[Nuvar]]. This occurs while its pilot, [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]], is seeking for a route that spans the entire galaxy. This route later becomes the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].<ref name="TEA" />
